paragraphs.text: The Eye of Yawgmoth is an artifact from Phyrexia associated with the Phyrexian progenitor Yawgmoth .

The Eye of Yawgmoth was a Phyrexian recording device. It was implanted in Belbe 's body soon after she had been killed and resurrected by Phyrexians . The device was directly connected to Yawgmoth , who, through it, could see everything. It was used by Yawgmoth to observe Rath and the conflict between Ertai , Greven il-Vec , and Crovax . Belbe eventually fell in love with Ertai and tried to blind the Eye with mana -radiation to sever its connection. Belve was eventually killed by Eladamri during Crovax's Coronation , which likely destroyed the eye or led to its abandonment.
